description: This file contains shell script code for testing the migration of Git ref storage backends between different formats (files, reftable). It includes functions for printing reflog entries, performing migration tests, and various test cases for different migration scenarios, error conditions, and repository states.

methods.name: print_all_reflog_entries
methods.description: Prints all reflog entries for a given repository by iterating over reflogs and outputting each entry.

methods.name: test_migration
methods.description: Performs migration of a Git repository's ref storage format, verifies correctness by comparing expected and actual refs and reflogs, and supports various test scenarios.
